title: Reshape values
summary: reshape changes the layout of a tensor while keeping the same number of values.
introduction: reshape changes the layout of a tensor while keeping the same number of values. We will use a small example so you can follow each step.
learningObjectives: Use the example to answer a practice question

blocks.text: reshape changes the layout of a tensor while keeping the same number of values.
The output is [[1, 2, 3], [4, 5, 6]]. Six values fit two rows of three.

items: Read the example from top to bottom. Point to the part that uses the new idea.
Explain what changed in your own words. Check the example again if you get stuck.

blocks.title: A common mistake
blocks.text: A new shape must contain the same total number of values.
For more detail later, use this [PyTorch further reading](https://pytorch.org/tutorials/beginner/basics/intro.html).
